details:
Summary

Since the Unity 6 builds (2026.3.3, Unity 6000.0.67f1-DWR), VRChat intermittently triggers a GPU timeout (LiveKernelEvent 0x141, VIDEO_ENGINE_TIMEOUT_DETECTED). The Windows live dump identifies VRChat.exe as the guilty process. A few seconds after the TDR, VRChat hard-crashes (no crash handler) with an access violation writing to address 0 on the UnityGfxDeviceWorker thread. It looks like a Map/allocation returns NULL after the device is removed and the result is not checked.

Occurrences (JST)

- 2026-09-21 23:58  build 1915  driver 610.74  Desktop  DominoRooftop

- 2026-09-22 01:54  build 1915  driver 610.74  VR       Binaural ASMR Room

- 2026-09-28 04:51  build 1917  driver 610.88  VR       small room

- 2026-10-03 20:19  build 1919  driver 610.88  Desktop  Idle Home

All four: different worlds, modes and players. The only common factor is that an AVPro video player was playing YouTube via "MF-MediaEngine-Hardware" (640x360).

Crash signature (identical in all VRChat dumps)

- Exception: 0xC0000005, write to 0x0

- Thread: UnityGfxDeviceWorker

- Crash IP: UnityPlayer.dll+0x19eb468 / +0x19eb3ff (AVX memcpy, dst = NULL, size 0x40 / 0x100)

- Call chain: UnityPlayer.dll+0x6cca4b -> +0x1f09940 -> +0x4c3837 -> +0x11cd377 -> +0x1167b70

- nvlddmkm Event ID 153 is logged ~3-5 s before each crash.

- In the 10/03 event, another D3D11 app running at the same time (osu!lazer) also received DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_REMOVED and exited.

Expected

VRChat should recover from (or at least handle) device removal instead of writing to a NULL mapped pointer.

System

- GPU: GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16GB (Palit, stock clocks, <70°C under load)

- CPU: Ryzen 7 9700X / RAM: 64GB

- OS: Windows 11 25H2 (26200), D3D11

- HMD: Quest 3 via Virtual Desktop

- Hardware checks: OCCT VRAM test 0 errors, 0 WHEA errors, no overclock

- Drivers tested: 610.74, 610.88 (also 616.92, which caused more TDRs in general)

Not yet tested

- --disable-hw-video-decoding (will update)

Logs and dumps (output_log, VRChat crash .dmp, WATCHDOG .dmp) are available and will be submitted via a support ticket referencing this post.
title: [Unity 6] TDR caused by VRChat.exe during AVPro HW-decoded video playback, then hard crash in UnityGfxDeviceWorker (NULL memcpy in UnityPlayer.dll)
